# Resources for this section

The [Generative AI overview](generative-index.qmd) already compares RAG, GANs, LLMs, GPT, autoencoders and Transformers, and includes the original transformer figure.

The 3Blue1Brown video *Transformers (how LLMs work) explained visually* is embedded on [ANN: model and demos](/ann/ann-model-and-demos.qmd).

## Generative AI

- [Generative AI in a Nutshell - how to survive and thrive in the age of AI](https://youtu.be/2IK3DFHRFfw?feature=shared){.external target='_blank'}
- [Generative AI in a Nutshell: poster](https://blog.crisp.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/generative-AI-in-a-nutshell.png){.external target='_blank'}

## Papers and books

- <span class="chip chip-warning">paper</span> [Attention Is All You Need](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2017/file/3f5ee243547dee91fbd053c1c4a845aa-Paper.pdf){.external target='_blank'} — the 2017 Transformer paper. A [reader's guide](attention-is-all-you-need.qmd) walks through it; the story that leads to it is in [The evolution of attention](evolution-of-attention.qmd).
- <span class="chip chip-warning">paper</span> [Generative Adversarial Nets](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2014/file/f033ed80deb0234979a61f95710dbe25-Paper.pdf){.external target='_blank'} — the 2014 GAN paper (NIPS 2014; also on [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/1406.2661){.external target='_blank'}). A walk-through of the game, the training loop and a tiny live example is in [Generative adversarial networks](gans.qmd).
- [LLM Engineer's Handbook: Master the art of engineering large language models from concept to production ](https://www.packtpub.com/en-us/product/llm-engineers-handbook-9781836200062?srsltid=AfmBOorsghxj1A2sZIK6UQc4ZwnKaaQ2vD5_mKI-ke1-LL-N984ALpOt){.external target='_blank'}
- [Repo](https://github.com/SylphAI-Inc/LLM-engineer-handbook){.external target='_blank'}
